text:
Th e sweet musk of rot wafting through the Wealdwoods, the cries of pain echoing in the Umbrawells, nothing gathers the beady-eyed 
scavick as much as an easy meal. Like to maggots in a corpse, these rodents have managed to burrow themselves in every environment 
of Sol'Kesh. Highly adaptive to their surroundings and capable of surviving on everything from spoiled meat to lichen, they have 
multiplied and spread profusely. Skittish when alone, they often run in mischiefs lead by the largest female. While preferring to slink 
under the cover of darkness to scavenge the bloody remains of another predator's hunt, when confronted or desperate, the mischief 
will try to surround and overwhelm the aggressor, relying on their quick reflexes and rancid quills to take down more ferocious beasts.

Multiattack Th e scavick makes two attacks, it can use its Rancid 
Claws, Infectious Bite or Quill Fling in any combination.

Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage.
Infectious Bite Melee Attack Roll: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 
Hit: 5 (2d4) Piercing damage. Constitution Saving Th row: DC 13, one 
creature that the scavick has successfully hit with its Infectious 
Bite attack. Failure: 9 (2d8) Poison damage. Success: Half damage. 
Quill FlingRanged Attack Roll: +5 to hit, range 10 ft. / 30ft., one target. 
Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage. Constitution Saving Th row: DC 13, 
one creature that the scavick has successfully hit with its Quill Fling

Aggressive Instinct (1/Day) Spurned on by the plights of its kin, the 
scavick lash out with instinctive revenge.
Reaction - Trigger: When a friendly scavick it can see within 30 ft. 
of it is slain. Response - Dexterity Saving Th row: DC 12, the scavick. 
Success: If within melee attack range, the scavick makes a Rancid 
Claws attack against the target creature.
Encountering Th e scavick is fi rst and foremost a pack animal, 
and if a Traveler chances upon a single rodent, there’s a high 
chance that several lay in wait, ready to pounce. As a creature 
with an instinctive ability to know when to flee and when to 
attack, interacting with them means playing to their instincts. 
If a Traveler wishes to capture one, feigning a limp may draw 
them out, and hopefully not too many of them.
Skills Acrobatics +5, Perception +3, Stealth +5
Twitching Senses Th e scavick has Advantage on Wisdom 
(Perception) checks that rely on smell and hearing.
Pack Scavenger Th e scavick has Advantage on attack rolls against 
a creature if at least one of the scavick’s allies is within 5 ft. of the 
creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.
Natural Ambusher Th e scavick has Advantage on Attack rolls 
against any creature it has Surprised.
